_comment: Backup of the SageReasoning practice hooks block for .claude/settings.local.json. This is the canonical 'ON' state used by the /practice-on and /practice-off skills (renamed at Trust Layer S8 from /sage-on and /sage-off, which remain as deprecated pointer stubs). Contains NO credential (the SAGE_GATE1_CREDENTIAL lives in the settings 'env' block, not here). /practice-off refreshes this file with whatever hooks are currently installed before removing them; /practice-on merges this 'hooks' object back in. Hooks: H1 UserPromptSubmit (top-level framing), H2 PreToolUse Task|Agent (subagent framing + S8 spawn-time discernment/L4 when provisioned — 120s timeout to cover the discernment budget), H3 PreToolUse Bash|Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit (at-action: guard + consult + loop-closure + S8 trust-verdict advisory), H4 Stop (reflect turn + accred + persistReflection), H5 PostToolUse Task|Agent (S8 delegation hand-back — A9 justice-failure classification + A8/A9 trust events). The S8 surfaces are DARK until SUBSTRATE_TRUST_CORE_ENABLED is set server-side AND discernment.config.json is provisioned; un-provisioned installs behave exactly as the pre-S8 H1-H4 harness.
